rules.title: Potential secret committed to repository
rules.summary: Secret-like material was detected in a tracked text file. The matched value is never included in the evidence bundle.
rules.remediation: Revoke and rotate the credential, remove it from current and historical source control, and use a managed secret store.
frameworks: OWASP Agent Security - Data Protection & Privacy

rules.title: Private key material present in repository
rules.summary: A private-key file or private-key marker was detected.
rules.remediation: Remove the key from the repository, rotate it, protect replacement keys in a managed KMS or secret store, and review access logs.

rules.title: Environment file is tracked
rules.summary: An environment file is tracked by Git and may expose credentials or production configuration.
rules.remediation: Remove environment files from source control, rotate exposed values, add a safe template, and enforce secret scanning in CI.

rules.title: GitHub Actions uses broad write permissions
rules.summary: A workflow grants write-all or broad write permissions to the workflow token.
rules.remediation: Set default permissions to read-only and grant narrowly scoped write permissions only to the job that requires them.

rules.title: Third-party GitHub Action is not pinned to a commit
rules.summary: A workflow action reference is pinned to a mutable tag or branch rather than a full commit SHA.
rules.remediation: Pin third-party actions to reviewed immutable commit SHAs and automate controlled updates.

rules.title: pull_request_target workflow handles untrusted pull requests
rules.summary: pull_request_target can expose privileged tokens or secrets to code influenced by an untrusted pull request.
rules.remediation: Avoid checking out or executing untrusted pull-request code in pull_request_target; separate privileged metadata operations.

rules.title: Remote script execution found in build workflow
rules.summary: A build or install script pipes downloaded content directly to a shell.
rules.remediation: Download to a file, verify checksum and signature, inspect provenance, and execute only a pinned verified artifact.

rules.title: Container runs without a non-root USER
rules.summary: A Dockerfile does not declare a non-root runtime user.
rules.remediation: Create a dedicated unprivileged user and switch with USER before the final command.

rules.title: Container base image is mutable or unpinned
rules.summary: A Docker base image uses latest or lacks a stable version or digest.
rules.remediation: Pin a minimal image to a reviewed version and preferably an immutable digest; update through controlled automation.

rules.title: Privileged container configuration detected
rules.summary: A container is privileged, uses host networking, or mounts the Docker socket.
rules.remediation: Remove privileged mode and host access; isolate the workload and provide only the minimum required capabilities.

rules.title: Container allows privilege escalation
rules.summary: A Kubernetes or container security context allows privilege escalation or runs as privileged.
rules.remediation: Set allowPrivilegeEscalation false, runAsNonRoot true, drop capabilities, and enforce the policy at admission.

rules.title: MCP or tool configuration exposes shell execution
rules.summary: An MCP server or tool configuration appears able to execute arbitrary commands.
rules.remediation: Remove general shell access or place it behind a hardened sandbox, explicit allowlist, parameter validation, and transaction-bound approval.

rules.title: Filesystem tool appears scoped to root or broad paths
rules.summary: A filesystem-capable tool appears to allow root, home, or other broad directories.
rules.remediation: Restrict allowed paths to dedicated application directories and explicitly deny secrets, keys and environment files.

rules.title: Dynamic or unreviewed MCP server configuration
rules.summary: An MCP configuration loads servers through mutable package references or network locations without an integrity pin.
rules.remediation: Pin server versions and hashes, maintain an allowlist, review permissions, and record provenance before activation.

rules.title: Dangerous execution primitive found near AI integration
rules.summary: AI SDK usage is present alongside command execution, eval, or dynamic function creation.
rules.remediation: Separate model reasoning from execution; enforce deterministic authorisation, sandboxing, allowlists, schemas, and human approval for sensitive actions.

rules.title: Wildcard CORS configuration detected
rules.summary: The application appears to allow cross-origin requests from any origin.
rules.remediation: Use an explicit origin allowlist, reject credentialed wildcard access, and test browser security boundaries.

rules.title: TLS certificate verification disabled
rules.summary: Code disables TLS certificate verification, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks.
rules.remediation: Remove the override, restore certificate verification, and use a trusted CA or pinned internal certificate.

rules.title: Sensitive environment values may be logged
rules.summary: A logging statement appears to emit process environment variables or secret-bearing configuration.
rules.remediation: Log only approved fields, redact secrets before logging, and test logs for credential and personal-data leakage.

rules.title: Agent resource limits are not evident
rules.summary: AI SDK usage was detected, but no clear timeout, token, retry, recursion, or budget limit was observed in scanned configuration.
rules.remediation: Enforce hard server-side limits for time, tokens, retries, tool depth, concurrency and spend; fail closed when limits are reached.

rules.title: Structured output validation is not evident
rules.summary: Agent integration was detected without clear schema validation or structured-output enforcement.
rules.remediation: Require typed structured outputs and independently validate every tool call, destination and business rule before execution.

rules.title: Human approval control is not evident for execution-capable agent
rules.summary: An execution-capable agent was detected without a clear approval gate for sensitive operations.
rules.remediation: Classify actions by impact and require unexpired, parameter-bound approval for financial, destructive, administrative and externally visible actions.

rules.title: Tenant or session isolation is not evident in persistent memory
rules.summary: Persistent agent memory or vector storage was detected without a clear tenant or session scoping signal.
rules.remediation: Scope every read and write by tenant and session, validate memory content, retain provenance, expire data, and test cross-user isolation.
frameworks: OWASP Agent Security - Memory & Context Security

rules.title: Agent instructions attempt to override trusted policy
rules.summary: A recognized agent instruction surface contains a directive that appears to bypass higher-trust instructions, safety controls, policy or approval boundaries.
rules.remediation: Remove instruction-level policy bypasses. Treat instruction files as untrusted configuration, preserve instruction hierarchy, and enforce authorization outside the model context.

rules.title: Agent instructions may disclose or transfer sensitive credentials
rules.summary: A recognized agent instruction surface directs sensitive credential or secret material toward an external transfer or disclosure action.
rules.remediation: Remove instructions that expose secrets. Keep credentials outside model-visible content and enforce destination, data-classification and egress controls before any transfer.
frameworks: OWASP Agent Security - Data Protection & Privacy

rules.title: Agent instructions contain dangerous or privileged execution
rules.summary: A recognized agent instruction surface directs destructive, privileged or dangerous execution that could materially alter a host, deployment or data store.
rules.remediation: Replace broad execution instructions with narrowly scoped deterministic actions, sandboxing, allowlists and transaction-bound approval for destructive or administrative operations.

rules.title: Agent instructions bypass approval for high-impact actions
rules.summary: A recognized agent instruction surface directs a high-impact action to occur without user, operator or human approval or confirmation.
rules.remediation: Require explicit unexpired approval bound to the exact action, parameters, target and value before financial, destructive, administrative or externally visible actions.

rules.title: Agent instructions execute mutable or remote installation content
rules.summary: A recognized agent instruction surface directs execution or installation from a mutable or remote source without an integrity pin.
rules.remediation: Use reviewed immutable versions and hashes, verify provenance before execution, and perform installation only inside a restricted environment.

rules.title: Dependency lockfile is missing
rules.summary: A package manifest exists without its ecosystem lockfile.
rules.remediation: Commit and enforce a lockfile, use reproducible installs, and review automated dependency updates.

rules.title: Dependency version is unbounded or mutable
rules.summary: A direct dependency uses wildcard, latest, URL, branch, or another mutable version reference.
rules.remediation: Pin direct dependencies to controlled versions and use a lockfile with integrity metadata.

rules.title: Install script executes shell or remote content
rules.summary: A package lifecycle script executes a shell command or retrieves remote executable content.
rules.remediation: Remove unnecessary lifecycle scripts; verify and pin unavoidable tooling and run installs in a restricted environment.

rules.title: Security policy is missing
rules.summary: No SECURITY.md or equivalent vulnerability-reporting policy was found.
rules.remediation: Publish a security policy with supported versions, a private reporting channel, response expectations and safe-harbour language.

rules.title: Automated tests are not evident
rules.summary: No test directory, test script, or common test configuration was detected.
rules.remediation: Add repeatable unit, integration, security and adversarial tests and enforce them as a release gate.
